summary: Delete Record (BYOB): removes a record from a self-hosted backend by id when triggered.
description: When `delete` fires, the record targeted by the node's id input is removed from its class on the BYOB backend. `success`/`failure` (with structured `error`) report the outcome and `loading` spans the request. Deletion is final, and dependent Query Data nodes see the change only on their next `fetch`.
whenToUse: Destructive removal on a self-hosted backend. On the managed cloud backend use Delete Record (DeleteDbModelProperties). Prefer a soft-delete flag via Update Record when undo matters.
runtimeBehavior: Class choice and the id input are schema-generated (runtime-discovered).
